comments.body:
3rd year ITET here, as the other comments have said, a good strategy is wait for the solutions to come out before even bothering to solve series, it's a waste of time otherwise and super demoralizing since you can't figure it out(And trust, many can't, don't feel bad).   
As a 1st semster I would recommend really trying to understand well LinAlg and NuS, these subjects will be coming up more later on. (Don't worry too much about he magnetism part tho, won't have to think about it much till Electro magnetic fields and waves in semester 4)  
Otherwise my best advice is finding a nice group of friends and trying to get into a routine and working and discussing problems makes the pain a lot more bearable.  
Hope this helps, and good luck!
comments.author: Intell10
